honest_c3: C1 mac CPU fp32, single load — no GPU comparison
C2 50 tokens 한정 — small sample variance, single seed=42 for random baselines

C3 'random_vocab' is uniform over all 64K pieces — ignores natural unigram frequency distribution; a true unigram baseline would weight by training-corpus frequency, but we have no calibrated unigram counts on hand
C4 single prompt '안녕' — Korean prompt biases expected emit toward Korean; a balanced multi-prompt cross-language sweep would harden the verdict

C5 'better/worse' = Korean character count delta; this is a LEXICAL bookkeeping metric, NOT semantic content. CLM emit may have higher Korean count yet still produce gibberish; conversely random Korean-only may have 100% Korean characters while being maximally meaningless

C6 SentencePiece byte-fallback tokens (control chars, 0x00-0x1F bytes) are part of the 64K vocab and decode to control characters — random vocab sampling will have non-zero control-char rate by construction, not by substrate fault
